title: Left path normalization of the mixed Leray unit diagram
statement: For schemes X,Y,Z and maps f:X→Y, g:Y→Z, let I be any cochain complex of O_X-modules, K its homotopy image and F=Qh(K). Let e be the normalized direct-image composition isomorphism, c_h the normalized mixed Leray comparisons, and s the derived scalar-composition isomorphism. Let p=unit_ΓZ(Dfg K);RΓZ(unit_Dfg(K));RΓZ(e.inv(F)). Let b=factor_g(ΓY Df K);Sg(factor_f(ΓX K));SgSf(unit_ΓX(K)). Then p;c_g(Rf F);Sg(c_f(F))=b. No K-injectivity, boundedness or nonemptiness is assumed; sheaf and module localization universes are independent.

proof.text: Extract the chosen normalized direct-image composition unit equation at K, with all three sheaf-localization universes explicitly instantiated to the fixed w. Extract the mixed Leray unit equations for g at Df(K) and for f at K. Sectionwise normalization makes each underived Leray comparison the identity: extensionality on modules proves that identity, and its homotopy-composition factors cancel.

The fully proved private generic_first_layer lemma performs the composition-unit, naturality, and first-Leray pasting with abstract additive functors. Substitute the strict underived direct-image composition equality; map its unit equation by the global-sections derived functor and move the f unit across the g comparison by naturality. The explicit equality of source objects identifies global sections after direct image with scalar restriction of global sections; heq_comp transports the normalized g unit equation along it without unfolding derived localization choices. Specialize this lemma to the scheme functors and unfold only the scheme wrapper definitions; associativity gives p;c_g equal to the g scalar factor followed by Sg(unit_ΓY(Df K)) and Sg(RΓY(unit_Df(K))).

The fully proved private finish_unit_paste lemma maps the normalized mixed unit equation for f by Sg, prepends the g scalar factor, and substitutes the first-layer equality. Functoriality and associativity produce precisely b. No derived unit is canceled, and no boundedness or K-injectivity assumption is added.

lean.statement:
theorem mixedSections_left_unit_normalization
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) :
    let K := (HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj I
    let F := DerivedCategory.Qh.obj K
    let Df := RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom
    let Dfg := RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (f ≫ g).toLRSHom.toShHom
    let HX := RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace
    let HY := RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor Y.toRingedSpace
    let HZ := RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor Z.toRingedSpace
    let Sf := ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u}
      (R := (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤))
      (S := (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤)) f.appTop.hom
    let Sg := ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u}
      (R := (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤))
      (S := (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤)) g.appTop.hom
    let e := schemeNormalizedDirectImageCompIso f g
    let p := HZ.rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app ((Dfg.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj K) ≫
      (schemeDerivedGlobalSections Z).map (Dfg.rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app K) ≫
      (schemeDerivedGlobalSections Z).map (e.inv.app F)
    let b := Sg.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.inv.app
        ((HY.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj ((Df.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj K)) ≫
      (schemeGlobalScalarRestriction g).map
        (Sf.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.inv.app ((HX.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj K)) ≫
      (schemeGlobalScalarRestriction g).map
        ((schemeGlobalScalarRestriction f).map (HX.rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app K))
    p ≫ (mixedGlobalSectionsDirectImageIso g).hom.app
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj F) ≫
      (schemeGlobalScalarRestriction g).map
        ((mixedGlobalSectionsDirectImageIso f).hom.app F) = b
